calibrations.rationale: Shot 5 contained water was explicitly accepted by human visual review and produced stable same-camera frozen-layer differentials at all five review beats. The production floor is intentionally conservative at roughly half the weakest approved visual contribution and requires a majority of review beats. This v1 calibration is benchmark-exact: it must not be inherited by open-water, vessel-handoff, or numinous-underwater layers until those material classes have their own human-approved calibration evidence.
